classification_authority.rule: The current entries are authoritative provenance classifications. The explicitly corrected merge-tool serialization classification supersedes the preserved D1 spec/collector rule; all retained source bytes and all other classifications remain unchanged.

intentional_exclusions.reason: Root capture transport wrappers duplicate the exact decoded raw files. Selectively retained code-review wrappers are separately named fixed files and actually cited by original reviewer reports.

Complete operator ZIPs and executable payloads are intentionally absent from the repository archive. Their artifact API digests, exact manifest members, author download observations and independent full-payload verification reports are retained. No downloaded binary is executed by this collector.

intentional_exclusions.reason: Not evidence. The fixed specification must be deliberately amended before freezing to add a necessary new original.

intentional_exclusions.reason: Already bound to immutable Git candidates; they are not duplicated or rewritten in this stage evidence directory.

Control files remain in scratch. Their identities, every admitted source file identity, root report-read declaration, runtime identity, reference closure and omissions are embedded in the generated archive manifest; the collector does not grant independent review credit.

manifest_scope: This author-generated manifest does not hash itself; retained originals are copied byte for byte, including original BOM/CRLF. Original reports keep their historical verdicts and original absolute scratch references; each entry maps those paths to the repository archive.

operator_archives_not_copied.scope: Complete operator ZIP is deliberately not copied into the repository; exact manifest, Actions artifact metadata, author download observation and independent payload verification report are retained. provenance_revision.freeze_source_interpretation: The unchanged freeze_source binds the original D1 collection input and bytes. Preserved v1 spec/collector/freeze classification metadata is historical where explicitly superseded by classification_authority.
provenance_revision.publication_check_interpretation: The preserved publication-check records the original D1 manifest hash, not the revised manifest hash.
provenance_revision.scope: Author correction of one kind/representation and derived counts; not a new collector run, source capture, native result or independent acceptance

reference_closure.scope: Closure of explicit stage-evidence filename references in retained reviewer reports/derived records and author native/operator/formatter records, matching structured path/bytes/SHA pins and unambiguous Markdown filename/SHA/byte-count pins; repository source citations and artifact-internal generic member names are not claims of duplicated source files. Raw GitHub records, full job logs and helper source literals are not treated as evidence-reference catalogues.
